story.title: A Documentary Without a Hero
story.moral_ar: رواية الواقع بأمانة تعني توثيق الأدوار المختلفة واحترام الموافقة والسياق، لا صناعة بطل منفرد.
story.art_style: Documentary editorial watercolor with realistic original characters and careful facial expressions; no image typography.

character_sheet.description: A 26-year-old documentary filmmaker with short dark curls, tan skin, plum field jacket, dark jeans and compact camera.

character_sheet.name: Simon
character_sheet.description: A 28-year-old sound editor with fair skin, glasses, short blond hair, navy windbreaker and headphones.

character_sheet.name: Ada
character_sheet.description: A 58-year-old craftswoman with deep brown skin, silver-streaked braids, ochre shirt and calm expression.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Yara arrived in the riverside district planning to make a documentary about an endangered craft tradition. Her initial proposal centered on Ada, a celebrated basket maker whose work had attracted international attention. Yet within hours, Yara noticed that the workshop depended on apprentices, suppliers, and neighbors missing from her proposed **narrative**. Simon, the sound editor, wondered whether presenting Ada as a solitary genius would create a misleading **simplification**. Yara defended the plan as a way of helping audiences follow a complicated story, but his objection unsettled her. She began to question the film's central **premise**, realizing that the most dramatic character was not necessarily the only person worth understanding. Before recording further interviews, she revised her outline to examine the workshop as a web of relationships rather than a monument to one exceptional individual.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: An elegant film can still leave out the truth, Yara admitted.

paragraphs.translation_ar: وصلت يارا لتصوير فيلم عن حرفة تقليدية مهددة، وكانت تنوي تقديم الحرفية آدا بطلة منفردة. لكن الورشة تعتمد على متدربين وموردين وجيران. تساءل سيمون إن كان هذا الأسلوب اختزالًا مضللًا. دافعت يارا عن حبكة واضحة، لكنها أعادت النظر في فرضيتها وخطة المقابلات لتوثيق العلاقات المتشابكة. قالت إن الفيلم الأنيق قد يهمل الحقيقة.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Although the workshop manager had approved filming, Ada questioned whether that authorization covered every worker present. One apprentice disliked appearing on camera while she was applying for employment elsewhere. Yara recognized that institutional permission could not substitute for individual **consent**, particularly when participants occupied different positions of authority. Simon suggested a clearer **protocol**: explain the film's purposes, identify possible audiences, and allow people to withdraw without pressure from supervisors. Ada insisted that these conversations happen privately, where no one would feel obliged to please an employer. The revised arrangements slowed production, yet they allowed more meaningful **participation**. Yara also promised to discuss any change in distribution plans: an agreement to appear at a neighborhood screening was not necessarily an agreement to an unrestricted international release. Trust, she discovered, could not be reduced to one signature.

segments.speaker: MALE
segments.text: Permission is a continuing conversation, not merely a document, Simon said.

paragraphs.translation_ar: وافق مدير الورشة على التصوير، لكن آدا تساءلت إن كانت موافقته تشمل كل العاملين. رفضت متدربة الظهور لأسباب وظيفية، فأدركت يارا أن إذن المؤسسة لا يغني عن موافقة الفرد. وضع سيمون بروتوكولًا يوضح الغرض والمشاهدين وحق الانسحاب دون ضغط. أبطأت الإجراءات العمل لكنها دعمت المشاركة والثقة. قال سيمون إن الموافقة حوار مستمر لا ورقة واحدة.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: During an interview, Ada recalled a period when cheap imported goods had almost destroyed the local market. Yara considered turning the recollection into the documentary's emotional climax, but Ada rejected the word **collapse**. Craftspeople, she explained, had adapted through teaching and cooperation long before sales recovered. The distinction altered the film's **framing**: did it portray a helpless community rescued by a hero, or resourceful people responding to difficult circumstances? Simon recommended comparing the interviews with old sales figures and newspaper archives. The evidence revealed a more complicated **trajectory** of decline, invention, and uneven recovery. Yara rewrote her narration to reflect uncertainty rather than forcing a tidy rise-and-fall structure. She feared that the change might disappoint viewers, yet she increasingly believed that complexity could deepen their attention rather than weaken it.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: We survived through many small decisions, not one miracle, Ada reminded her.

paragraphs.translation_ar: روت آدا كيف أضرت الواردات الرخيصة بالحرفة، ورفضت وصف تلك الفترة بأنها انهيار تام لأن الحرفيين تأقلموا بالتعليم والتعاون. فهمت يارا أن الصياغة تحدد هل يظهر المجتمع عاجزًا أم قادرًا على الابتكار. قارن سيمون الشهادات بسجلات المبيعات، فظهر مسار معقد من التراجع والتجدد والتعافي غير المتساوي. أعادت يارا كتابة السرد دون فرض حبكة سهلة. قالت آدا إن البقاء جاء من قرارات كثيرة لا معجزة واحدة.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: As filming continued, Yara realized that apprentices performed much of the preparation while experienced artisans received nearly all the public **visibility**. A young worker agreed to discuss this imbalance if her comments were not used to attack Ada personally. Simon worried that selective editing would manufacture an unnecessary conflict and damage important relationships. Instead of collecting provocative statements, Yara organized a group conversation about training, working hours, and financial **compensation**. Genuine disagreements emerged, but the workshop's attempts at reform were also evident. Ada accepted criticism while challenging any portrayal that converted complex negotiations into convenient **antagonism**. Yara began to understand that representing conflict responsibly required explaining why people held different positions, not simply cutting between opposing sentences. Afterwards, she checked the relevant permissions once more and noted how each participant understood the purpose of the discussion.

segments.speaker: MALE
segments.text: Our audience deserves more than the loudest disagreement, Simon observed.

paragraphs.translation_ar: لاحظت يارا أن المتدربين يقومون بأعمال كثيرة بينما تذهب الشهرة للكبار. وافقت متدربة على الحديث بشرط ألا تُستخدم كلماتها للهجوم على آدا. خشيت يارا من صناعة نزاع بالمونتاج، فرتبت نقاشًا جماعيًا عن التدريب والأجر. ظهرت الخلافات ومحاولات الإصلاح معًا. أدركت أن توثيق الصراع يتطلب شرح أسباب المواقف لا جمع أكثر العبارات حدة. قال سيمون إن الجمهور يستحق أكثر من الخلاف الأعلى صوتًا.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The first edited version followed Ada almost continuously, despite Yara's revised intentions. Simon noticed that dramatic music and carefully chosen close-ups encouraged viewers to overlook important qualifications. There was no outright lie, but the rhythm of the film created a kind of emotional **manipulation**. Yara initially defended every decision, recalling the long hours required to assemble the footage. A private screening, however, showed that audiences interpreted cautious memories as declarations of absolute certainty. She removed several musical cues, restored moments of **ambiguity**, and changed the **sequence** of scenes to show apprentices teaching one another. These adjustments made the documentary less heroic but more faithful to what had actually happened. Yara came to appreciate that editing was not simply a technical process; every cut expressed a judgment about whose experience deserved attention and which doubts could remain visible.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: The person holding the camera also holds considerable power, Yara said.

paragraphs.translation_ar: رغم نية يارا الجديدة، ركزت النسخة الأولى على آدا. جعلت الموسيقى واللقطات القريبة الجمهور يتجاهل التحفظات، وهو تلاعب عاطفي دون كذب مباشر. كشف عرض خاص أن تصريحات حذرة بدت يقينية. خففت يارا الموسيقى وأعادت لحظات الالتباس وعرضت عمل المتدربين. أدركت أن كل لقطة أو حذف يحمل قرارًا أخلاقيًا عن صاحب الحق في الظهور. قالت إن من يحمل الكاميرا يحمل سلطة كبيرة.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Before submitting the film to a festival, Yara arranged a private screening for everyone who had agreed to participate. Its purpose was not to grant any individual complete **editorial** control, but to identify factual errors, unintended risks, and serious distortions. Ada explained that a remark filmed in anger sounded harsher without its surrounding conversation. An apprentice requested that an identifying detail be removed because it could affect future **employment**. Simon recorded the concerns and explained which changes could be made without falsifying the film's argument. The team established a transparent **review** process while acknowledging that disagreement might remain after corrections. Yara discovered that collaborative accountability did not require abandoning artistic judgment; it required taking responsibility for the foreseeable consequences of her decisions. Participants appreciated being listened to even when their suggestions were not adopted in precisely the form they requested.

segments.speaker: MALE
segments.text: Listening belongs inside the editing process, Simon said.

paragraphs.translation_ar: قبل مهرجان العرض رتبت يارا مشاهدة خاصة للمشاركين بهدف كشف الأخطاء والمخاطر، دون منح أي فرد سلطة كاملة على التحرير. اعترضت آدا على جملة مقتطعة من سياق غضب، وطلبت متدربة حذف تفصيل قد يضر مستقبلها المهني. سجل سيمون الطلبات وحدود التعديل، ووُضعت مراجعة شفافة. أدركت يارا أن المساءلة لا تلغي الاستقلال الفني بل تضبط عواقبه. قال سيمون إن الإصغاء جزء من المونتاج.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The festival publicity department proposed advertising the documentary as the story of a woman who single-handedly saved a dying tradition. Yara rejected the suggested **promotion**, even though a simpler slogan might attract a larger audience. She offered an alternative emphasizing cooperation and **resilience** without casting the community as helpless. One producer warned that the wording lacked dramatic impact, but Yara replied that marketing should not contradict the film itself. Ada welcomed the decision, arguing that tales of exceptional heroes often made ordinary contributions disappear. The team created an exhibition beside the screening, displaying tools, photographs, and workshop materials with careful **attribution**. It allowed visitors to explore relationships that the documentary could only briefly introduce. When audiences responded enthusiastically, Yara saw that truthful complexity and compelling art were not necessarily enemies. The most memorable comments praised the film's attention to cooperation rather than its refusal to manufacture a savior.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: No one saved this place alone, Ada told visitors.

paragraphs.translation_ar: أراد فريق الدعاية وصف الفيلم بأنه قصة امرأة أنقذت الحرفة وحدها. رفضت يارا الشعار واقترحت التعاون والقدرة على الصمود. رأت آدا أن قصص الأبطال تمحو المساهمات الصغيرة. أعد الفريق معرضًا للأدوات والصور مع نسبها إلى أصحابها، فكشف العلاقات التي لم يتسع الفيلم لشرحها. أظهر تفاعل الجمهور أن التعقيد الصادق قد يكون جذابًا. قالت آدا إن أحدًا لم ينقذ المكان وحده.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: After the premiere, critics praised the documentary's careful tone, although several complained that its ending lacked a decisive resolution. Yara refused to invent a comforting future for the workshop. Orders had increased, but many apprentices still faced irregular incomes, and negotiations about training were unfinished. To avoid exaggerating the film's **impact**, she separated measurable changes from personal impressions. Simon proposed a follow-up interview after six months, provided all participation remained **voluntary**. Ada welcomed the possibility but insisted that her workshop should decide whether further filming would be **appropriate**. Yara agreed that access was a privilege rather than a permanent claim on people's lives. The film's apparent success had not erased their obligations to participants, whose circumstances would continue changing long after the festival ended. They documented these boundaries before accepting requests from broadcasters interested in wider distribution.

segments.speaker: MALE
segments.text: Our responsibility continues beyond the final credits, Simon said.

paragraphs.translation_ar: مدح النقاد الفيلم، واشتكى بعضهم من غياب خاتمة حاسمة. رفضت يارا اختراع مستقبل سعيد للورشة؛ فقد زادت الطلبات لكن دخل بعض المتدربين ظل غير مستقر. ميزت الأثر المقاس من الانطباعات، واقترح سيمون مقابلة لاحقة طوعية. أصرت آدا على أن قرار التصوير يعود للمشاركين، ووافقت يارا على أن دخول حياتهم امتياز لا حق دائم. قال سيمون إن المسؤولية تستمر بعد شارة النهاية.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A year later, a film school used the documentary to examine the relationship between storytelling and **power**. Yara told students that her greatest discovery had been the limits of her own perspective. A camera offered extraordinary access, but its frame inevitably selected certain details while excluding others. She described how **accountability** had improved the film without eliminating disagreement, and how participants had challenged assumptions she never realized she held. Simon demonstrated how shifting a sound cue could change the viewer's perception of someone speaking. Ada joined the discussion remotely and explained that the workshop was still changing, independent of the film's story. Students asked whether a documentary could ever be entirely **objective**. Yara replied that perfection was impossible, but careful sourcing, shared scrutiny, and openness about limitations could make a project more trustworthy. Their questions mattered more to her than a flattering award.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: Responsibility begins when we admit what our camera cannot show, Yara said.

paragraphs.translation_ar: بعد عام دُرّس الفيلم في معهد سينما لبحث العلاقة بين السرد والسلطة. شرحت يارا أن الكاميرا تختار ما يظهر وما يغيب، وأن المساءلة حسنت العمل دون إزالة الخلاف. عرض سيمون كيف يغير صوت بسيط انطباع المشاهد، وذكرت آدا أن حياة الورشة تستمر خارج الفيلم. سأل الطلاب عن الموضوعية الكاملة، فأجابت يارا أن الكمال مستحيل لكن الأدلة والمراجعة والاعتراف بالحدود تزيد الثقة. قالت إن المسؤولية تبدأ بالاعتراف بما لا تظهره الكاميرا.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Returning to the riverside district, Yara found the workshop busy with new students, changing suppliers, and arguments about future wages. Nothing resembled the frozen ending that a conventional heroic documentary might have offered. She met Ada for tea without bringing a camera and listened to the latest news as a friend rather than a director. Simon later suggested keeping their research notes in a secure **archive**, with access conditions reflecting each contributor's preferences. Yara agreed that responsible **stewardship** involved protecting material even when nobody was currently interested in publishing it. The documentary had become one chapter in an unfolding history, not the history itself. Looking back, she understood that **integrity** came not from eliminating uncertainty but from resisting the temptation to hide it. She could still tell a powerful story, provided she never forgot that the people within it would continue living after the screen went dark.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: The best ending leaves room for other voices, Yara concluded.

paragraphs.translation_ar: عادت يارا إلى الورشة فوجدتها مليئة بطلاب جدد ونزاعات جديدة حول الأجور. لم تكن حياتهم خاتمة ثابتة لفيلم بطولي. التقت آدا دون كاميرا، وقرر سيمون حفظ المواد البحثية في أرشيف آمن يحترم تفضيلات المشاركين. فهمت يارا أن الرعاية المسؤولة تحمي المواد حتى حين لا توجد نية لنشرها. أدركت أن النزاهة لا تلغي عدم اليقين بل ترفض إخفاءه، وأن الأشخاص يواصلون حياتهم بعد إطفاء الشاشة. قالت إن النهاية الأفضل تترك مجالًا لأصوات أخرى.

Returning to the riverside district, Yara found the workshop busy with new students, changing suppliers, and arguments about future wages. Nothing resembled the frozen ending that a conventional heroic documentary might have offered.
